{"id":1809399954,"question_id":3768,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"9 months","timestamp":1761221676,"status":11,"status_display":"Wrong Answer","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1809399954/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Check If Digits Are Equal in String After Operations I","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    string operation(string &s)\n    {\n        queue<char>q;\n        for(auto ch : s) q.push(ch);\n\n        string ans = \"\";\n\n        int repeat = s.size()-1;\n        while(q.size()>=2 && repeat--)\n        {\n            int front = q.front() - '0'; \n            q.pop();\n            int next_front = q.front() - '0';\n            \n            int sum = (front + next_front) % 10;\n            q.push(sum + '0');\n        }\n        \n        while(!q.empty())\n        {\n            ans.push_back(q.front());\n            q.pop();\n        }\n        \n        return ans;\n    }\n    bool hasSameDigits(string s) {\n        string check = operation(s);\n        return check[0] == check[1];\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"check-if-digits-are-equal-in-string-after-operations-i","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":949}
